provider.description: Provider Data Catalog (Care Compare) datasets: hospitals, nursing homes, home health, hospice, dialysis. DKAN datastore query by dataset id.

dataset.desc: catalog alias (hospital_info) or Provider Data dataset id (xubh-q36u)

index.desc: distribution index inside the dataset; 0 = the dataset's CSV (every Provider Data dataset has one, verified 2026-10)

where.desc: equality filters {column: value}; a list value means IN. Column names are snake_case (state, citytown, facility_id)

conditions.desc: list of {property, value, operator}; operators = <> < <= > >= LIKE IN 'NOT IN' BETWEEN; LIKE uses % and is case-insensitive

sort.desc: column or -column (descending), or a list of them

columns.desc: list of columns to return (default all)

medicare.description: data.cms.gov data-api datasets (Medicare enrollment, geographic variation, spending by drug, inpatient and physician utilization) by dataset UUID.

dataset.desc: catalog alias (geo_variation) or data.cms.gov dataset UUID

where.desc: equality filters {COLUMN: value}; column names are as published (BENE_GEO_LVL). An unknown column is ignored by the API, so the adapter checks every filter column exists

columns.desc: list of columns to return (sent as column=A,B)

hospital_info.name: Hospital General Information
hospital_info.description: All Medicare-registered hospitals: address, type, ownership, emergency services, overall star rating

hospital_mortality.name: Complications and Deaths - Hospital
hospital_mortality.description: Hospital 30-day mortality, hip/knee complications, patient safety indicators

hospital_readmissions.name: Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program
hospital_readmissions.description: Excess readmission ratios by hospital and condition

hospital_infections.name: Healthcare Associated Infections - Hospital
hospital_infections.description: CLABSI, CAUTI, SSI, MRSA, C. difficile standardized infection ratios by hospital

hospital_timely_care.name: Timely and Effective Care - Hospital
hospital_timely_care.description: Emergency department times, sepsis, stroke, immunization and preventive care measures

hospital_spending.name: Medicare Spending Per Beneficiary - Hospital
hospital_spending.description: Medicare spending per episode relative to the national median, by hospital

hospital_patient_survey.name: Patient survey (HCAHPS) - Hospital
hospital_patient_survey.description: HCAHPS patient experience measures and star ratings by hospital

nursing_home_info.name: Nursing homes: Provider Information
nursing_home_info.description: Every Medicare/Medicaid nursing home: beds, ownership, five-star ratings, staffing, fines

nursing_home_deficiencies.name: Nursing homes: Health Deficiencies
nursing_home_deficiencies.description: Health inspection citations of the last three cycles: tag, scope and severity, correction date

nursing_home_quality.name: Nursing homes: MDS Quality Measures
nursing_home_quality.description: Minimum Data Set quality measures: falls, pressure ulcers, antipsychotic use

home_health_info.name: Home Health Care Agencies
home_health_info.description: Medicare-certified home health agencies: services offered, quality star rating

hospice_info.name: Hospice - General Information
hospice_info.description: Medicare-certified hospices: address, ownership, certification date

dialysis_info.name: Dialysis Facility - Listing by Facility
dialysis_info.description: Dialysis facilities: stations, ownership, star rating, quality measures

monthly_enrollment.name: Medicare Monthly Enrollment
monthly_enrollment.description: Medicare beneficiaries by month (and year totals, MONTH='Year'): Original Medicare vs Medicare Advantage, Part D; national, state, county; 2013-present

geo_variation.name: Medicare Geographic Variation - by National, State & County
geo_variation.description: Fee-for-service spending per capita (actual and standardized), utilization and demographics by year, state and county, 2014-2024

ma_geo_variation.name: Medicare Advantage Geographic Variation - National & State
ma_geo_variation.description: Medicare Advantage utilization by national and state level (encounter-based)

partd_spending_by_drug.name: Medicare Part D Spending by Drug
partd_spending_by_drug.description: Part D spending, claims, beneficiaries and unit cost by brand and generic name; wide format with one column set per year (Tot_Spndng_2020 ... _2024)

partb_spending_by_drug.name: Medicare Part B Spending by Drug
partb_spending_by_drug.description: Part B drug spending, claims and beneficiaries by HCPCS code; wide format by year

partd_opioid_geo.name: Medicare Part D Opioid Prescribing Rates - by Geography
partd_opioid_geo.description: Opioid claims and prescribing rates by national, state and county level and year

inpatient_geo_2024.name: Medicare Inpatient Hospitals - by Geography and Service (2024)
inpatient_geo_2024.description: Fee-for-service discharges and average charges/payments by DRG, national and state; one year per dataset

inpatient_provider_2024.name: Medicare Inpatient Hospitals - by Provider and Service (2024)
inpatient_provider_2024.description: Discharges and average charges/payments by hospital (CCN) and DRG; one year per dataset

physician_geo_2024.name: Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners - by Geography and Service (2024)
physician_geo_2024.description: Services, beneficiaries and average payments by HCPCS code, national and state; one year per dataset

partd_prescribers_geo_2024.name: Medicare Part D Prescribers - by Geography and Drug (2024)
partd_prescribers_geo_2024.description: Part D claims, costs and beneficiaries by drug, national and state; one year per dataset

market_saturation_county.name: Market Saturation & Utilization State-County
market_saturation_county.description: Providers, users and payments per type of service by state and county
